top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards the best-confirmed and most mature chain on the shortlist, from proglucagon processing and the incretin effect to the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide and drugs with proven glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit. The physiology-and-active-form citation to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov gives three separable, defensible contributions; the weaknesses (contested Mojsov priority, Habener outside the list, Knudsen omitted) concern credit and framing and do not justify withholding the prize.
